scenes.text: "French Vanilla for Ronnie. He always asks for this one."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Coffee shop. Tori picks up the drink, checks her Tamagotchi while walking out.]

scenes.text: "My little digital pet needs attention... Ronnie would laugh if he saw how attached I am to this thing."
scenes.internal: [She walks down the street, coffee in one hand, her original Tamagotchi in the other, not looking where she\'s going.]

scenes.text: THUD.
scenes.internal: [She bumps into an older man. Hard. Coffee nearly spills. Both their Tamagotchis tumble to the ground.]

scenes.text: "Oh my gosh, I\'m so sorry! I wasn\'t paying attention—"
scenes.internal: [She bends down quickly, embarrassed. Grabs the Tamagotchi closest to her hand.]

scenes.text: BUZZ. BUZZ.
scenes.internal: [The device vibrates in her hand. Twice. Sharp. Wrong. Something fundamental shifts.]

scenes.text: "What...? Mine never does that."
scenes.internal: [A wave of disorientation. The world tilts. Reality feels... thin. Unstable.]

scenes.text: "No problem. Hang on to that. It may save your life someday."
scenes.internal: [She glances up but never clearly sees his face. Just a glimpse of a faded BGA hoodie. He walks away with her original device.]

scenes.text: "That was... weird. I should get home. Feel off."
scenes.internal: [She walks, but everything feels distant. Muted. Like she\'s moving through water. Something is very wrong.]

scenes.text: And then... darkness.
scenes.internal: [Visual: Pure black. No sound. A void. She is nowhere and everywhere.]

scenes.text: "Wait... where am I? What happened? I was just walking..."
scenes.internal: [She has no body. No voice. Just consciousness floating in digital darkness.]

scenes.text: "HELLO?! Can anyone hear me?! RONNIE?!"
scenes.internal: [The words echo only inside her own mind. No sound escapes into the void.]

scenes.text: Echo 1: "...another one..."\nEcho 2: "...it\'s starting again..."\nDespair: "...fresh meat..."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Voices from nowhere. Other consciousnesses in this space.]

scenes.text: "Who\'s there?! Where am I?!"
scenes.internal: [The whispers grow louder, more distinct. Figures materializing from darkness.]

scenes.text: "You\'re in the device. The Tamagotchi. With us."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Three figures—Echo Toris. Similar but different. Worn down versions.]

scenes.text: "We\'re you. Previous loops. Different attempts. 847 failures."
scenes.internal: [Visual: The weight of their existence. Failed iterations.]

scenes.text: `"Welcome
scenes.internal: [Visual: Despair—the most worn down, the most bitter. She\'s given up entirely.]

scenes.text: "Cage?! No. I don\'t accept that. There has to be a way out!"
scenes.internal: [Even in confusion and fear, she refuses the narrative. This is different already.]

scenes.text: And then... sound. Muffled. Distant. The outside world bleeding through.
scenes.internal: [She can HEAR. Tinny, like through a tiny speaker. But she still can\'t see.]

scenes.text: "Hey babe, got your French Vanilla."
scenes.internal: [That\'s... her voice. But she\'s not speaking. Her body is moving without her.]

scenes.text: "RONNIE! RONNIE, I\'M IN HERE! THAT\'S NOT ME! CAN YOU HEAR ME?!"
scenes.internal: [She screams into the void. Nothing happens. The conversation continues outside.]

scenes.text: "He can\'t hear you. We all tried screaming. It doesn\'t work."
scenes.internal: [The weight of their experience. They know what doesn\'t work.]

scenes.text: "Ya sure I can look at it. Why do you call it Ronnie-Gatchi anyway?"
scenes.internal: [The conversation continuing. Normal. Casual. He has no idea.]

scenes.text: "Oh you know, because this thing is sooo cute. And what better way to name it than after my man - who\'s even cuter!"
scenes.internal: [Digital Tori (internal, horrified): "Wait... I\'m saying this. But SHE\'S saying this. We\'re both... the same words..."]

scenes.text: "I\'m speaking... but I\'m also watching myself speak... What\'s happening to me?!"
scenes.internal: [The horror of synchronization. Two Toris. One voice. One moment.]

scenes.text: "Well, SOMEONE keeps stealing my BGA hoodie, so this is my replacement."
scenes.internal: [The conversation continuing. Physical Tori responding normally. Digital Tori screaming silently.]

scenes.text: "Love you! I\'ll get dinner started"
scenes.internal: [Sound of movement. Footsteps. She\'s walking away.]

scenes.text: "Babe, watch ou—!"
scenes.internal: [Panic in his voice. Something\'s wrong!]

scenes.text: THUD.
scenes.internal: [A sickening impact. A clatter. Ronnie screaming her name. But she can\'t see. Can\'t help. Can only HEAR.]

scenes.text: "I HAVE TO SEE! I have to know what happened! RONNIE, PLEASE!"
scenes.internal: [Desperation. Pure, overwhelming need to witness. To understand. To help.]

scenes.text: She pushes. Not with body, but with consciousness. Every ounce of will focused on one thing: SEE.
scenes.internal: [And then... something gives.]

scenes.text: BUZZ. BUZZ.
scenes.internal: [But she doesn\'t notice. Too desperate. Too focused.]

scenes.text: ...WHOOSH.
scenes.internal: [Visual: The darkness TEARS OPEN. Light. Vision. A webcam feed.]

scenes.text: "I can... I can SEE! What—where am I?!"
scenes.internal: [Visual: Through a laptop camera. The apartment. And... her body on the floor.]

scenes.text: Her body. Unconscious. Blood from where her head hit. Ronnie on the phone with 911.
scenes.internal: [She is witnessing her own accident. From the outside. Through a camera. This is real.]

scenes.text: "No... no no no... That\'s me. That\'s MY body. I\'m... I\'m in a coma."
scenes.internal: [The full weight of understanding. She\'s not in her body anymore. She\'s watching it die.]

scenes.text: The connection falters. Unstable. The vision glitches, tears apart, and—
scenes.internal: [WHOOSH. She\'s yanked backward violently. The light is gone.]

scenes.text: "NO! Bring it back! I need to see! PLEASE!"
scenes.internal: [Darkness again. The void of the device. She\'s back. And she just watched herself fall.]

scenes.text: "...What. What did you just DO?!"
scenes.internal: [The Echoes are shaken. Something impossible just happened.]

scenes.text: "You DISAPPEARED. You were here, and then you just... VANISHED. Where did you GO?!"
scenes.internal: [Visual: Echoes staring at the space where she was. Then back at her. Disbelief.]

scenes.text: "I... I saw it. I saw her—ME—fall. There was blood. Ronnie was screaming. I watched myself..."
scenes.internal: [She\'s in shock. The horror of witnessing her own accident.]

scenes.text: "Where WERE you?! You weren\'t here! We\'ve been in this cage for... for YEARS. No one has ever left!"
scenes.internal: [Desperation in her voice. If Tori left... maybe escape is possible?]

scenes.text: "I don\'t know! I just... wanted to SEE so badly. I pushed, and suddenly I was in Ronnie\'s laptop!"
scenes.internal: [She\'s figuring it out as she speaks. Something about the desperation. The intent.]

scenes.text: "I saw through his camera! The outside world! My body on the floor! Then I was pulled back here..."
scenes.internal: [The Echoes are silent. Processing. This changes everything.]

scenes.text: "This... this has NEVER happened before. None of us... we never..."
scenes.internal: [Realization dawning. They never tried. They just accepted.]

scenes.text: "We all listened to Despair. She said escape was impossible. So we... just stopped trying."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Despair silent. Defensive. This challenges everything she believes.]

scenes.text: "It was a FLUKE. A glitch. It won\'t happen again. You\'re still trapped. We\'re ALL still trapped."
scenes.internal: [But her voice wavers. She\'s not as certain as she pretends.]

scenes.text: "But I DID it. I left. I SAW. If I did it once, I can do it again."
scenes.internal: [A new possibility is born. She proved Despair wrong. Once is enough.]

scenes.text: Time passes. Days? Weeks? Impossible to tell. Ronnie takes the device everywhere.
scenes.internal: [Visual: Darkness. Time montage. Tori attempts the hop repeatedly. Every attempt fails.]

scenes.text: "Come on... PUSH. Like before. I need to get to the laptop again!"
scenes.internal: [She concentrates. Pushes. Nothing happens. The void remains.]

scenes.text: "Why won\'t it WORK?! I did it before! What\'s different?!"
scenes.internal: [Frustration mounting. Maybe Despair was right. Maybe it was just a dying glitch.]

scenes.text: Through the device, muffled sounds. Ronnie\'s voice. Keyboard clicking. He\'s working on something.
scenes.internal: [She can hear him. But still can\'t see. Still stuck.]

scenes.text: "Let me try plugging you into the laptop... maybe I can pull the data..."
scenes.internal: [Sound of USB cable. A click. The device is connected to something.]

scenes.text: "Wait... the device is TOUCHING the laptop. Just like during the accident!"
scenes.internal: [The pattern. Physical contact. That was the difference.]

scenes.text: "Okay. The device is touching the laptop. I think... I think I can do this. But what if I mess up? What if it goes wrong?"

choices.text: Trust yourself. You can do this.

scenes.internal: [She hesitates at the edge. The jump that could change everything.]

scenes.text: dialogue
scenes.internal: internal

scenes.text: "NOW!"
scenes.internal: [She pushes. Same desperation. Same intent. But this time... with contact.]

scenes.text: BUZZ. BUZZ.
scenes.internal: [This time she FEELS it. The signal. The bridge activating.]

scenes.text: ...WHOOSH.
scenes.internal: [Visual: Light. Vision. She\'s IN. The laptop. She can see through the webcam again.]

scenes.text: "YES! I DID IT! The device has to be TOUCHING the target! That\'s the rule!"
scenes.internal: [The discovery. Physical contact enables the transfer. This is navigation, not luck.]

scenes.text: "She figured it out. The rule. Physical contact."
scenes.internal: [The Echoes watching in amazement. She\'s navigating. They never thought to try.]

scenes.text: "He\'s coding something... What is...? That sprite... that\'s ME."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Through laptop screen. Code editor. A web app. "Tori-gatchi."]

scenes.text: "A tamagotchi game?... with dialogue boxes. Text output!! This is it. This is how I can TALK to him!"
scenes.internal: [The plan forming. She can hijack the game. Use it to communicate.]

scenes.text: Days pass. She watches him code. Waiting for the right moment.
scenes.internal: [Visual: Time passage. Ronnie working. Tori planning. The Echoes watching.]

scenes.text: One day, Ronnie leaves the laptop. Takes only the device. She\'s back in the darkness.
scenes.internal: [Snap. The connection breaks. She\'s in the device again. Where is he going?]

scenes.text: Muffled sounds. Beeping. Hospital machines. The smell would be antiseptic if she could smell.
scenes.internal: [He brought the device to the hospital. Near her body.]

scenes.text: "Wait... what is this? I feel... something. Warmth? A pull?"
scenes.internal: [Abstract sensation. Different from the laptop. Magnetic. Calling.]

scenes.text: "It\'s different from the laptop feeling. What if I push toward it...?"
scenes.internal: [She concentrates. Reaches toward the sensation. Pushes.]

scenes.text: BUZZ.
scenes.internal: [Single. Not double. Different signal. The device vibrates once.]

scenes.text: "I made that happen. But... only one buzz. Not two. What does that mean?"
scenes.internal: [The difference. Double buzz = vessel transfer. Single buzz = something else.]

scenes.text: "Hmm. Battery acting up again. I should charge this when I get home."
scenes.internal: [He moves the device away. The pull fades. The warmth gone.]

scenes.text: "No! That was ME! Not the battery! But... why did it feel different?"
scenes.internal: [The mystery. Single buzz near body. Double buzz for vessel transfer. What\'s the connection?]

scenes.text: "Single buzz versus double buzz. Two different signals."
scenes.internal: [The Echoes analyzing. They\'re invested now. She\'s showing them something new.]

scenes.text: "We felt something like that too. Near the body. We dismissed it. Despair said it was irrelevant."
scenes.internal: [Another failure. They felt the pull but ignored it.]

scenes.text: "Because it IS irrelevant! It\'s just a phantom signal. The body is comatose. It means NOTHING."
scenes.internal: [But Despair sounds less certain. Defensive. She\'s being proven wrong repeatedly.]

scenes.text: "No. It means SOMETHING. I just don\'t know what yet. But I\'ll figure it out."
scenes.internal: [The mystery preserved. She knows there\'s a connection. She just doesn\'t understand it yet.]

scenes.text: Back home. Device on laptop again. Contact established. She hops deliberately.
scenes.internal: [Visual: She\'s getting better at this. The transfer is smoother now.]

scenes.text: "Okay. Let\'s see if this works. Launching Tori-gatchi..."
scenes.internal: [Through laptop: He clicks. The program opens. Her sprite appears on screen.]

scenes.text: "The game is running. Dialogue system is active. NOW. I sync with it NOW."
scenes.internal: [She pushes her consciousness toward the text output. Hijacking the dialogue box.]

scenes.text: "Baby? Is that you?"
scenes.internal: [Visual: Her words appearing in the dialogue box. Text she didn\'t code. SHE\'S SPEAKING.]

scenes.text: "What the... I didn\'t code that. What\'s happening?"
scenes.internal: [Through webcam: His face. Confused. Scared. Hopeful. Recognizing the speech pattern.]

scenes.text: "It\'s me! Tori! I\'m in the device! I\'ve been trying to reach you!"
scenes.internal: [Fighting to maintain the connection. Forcing words through the dialogue system.]

scenes.text: "I saw it happen. Through your laptop camera. I tripped on your shoe. There was blood. You called 911."
scenes.internal: [Details only she would know. Proof. Evidence. It\'s really her.]

scenes.text: "Oh my god. It IS you. You\'re really... you\'re in there. How is this possible?"
scenes.internal: [Breakthrough. Communication established. He believes. Finally.]

scenes.text: "She did it. She NAVIGATED instead of fighting the system."
scenes.internal: [The Echoes stunned. Despair silent. Everything they believed was wrong.]

scenes.text: "I can talk to him. I can MOVE. I\'m not trapped. This isn\'t a cage. It\'s a bridge."
scenes.internal: [The foundation established. Communication. Navigation. Hope.]

scenes.text: Act 1 complete. Communication achieved. The real work begins.
scenes.internal: [Visual: Tori and Ronnie connected through the game. Echo Toris watching. A new loop. A new possibility.]
